description: Na₅VO₅ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, corners with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.43 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with three equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids,  an edgeedge with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.52 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one VO₅ trigonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent VO₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.51 Å. V is bonded to five O atoms to form VO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with six equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.95 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₄V square pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅V octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄V square pyramids, edges with four equivalent ONa₅V octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄V square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-69°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one V atom to form distorted ONa₅V octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₅V octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₄V square pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₅V octahedra, and edges with four equivalent ONa₄V square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-31°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one V atom.
